fx.method: Exact United Kingdom rows, 2017-08-14 to 2017-09-29. Upstream inverts DEXUSUK; these rounded values are GBP per USD. No interpolation. Secondary source, not independently reconciled to the primary H.10 feed.
fx.reuse: datasets preparation PDDL; Federal Reserve public-domain data with attribution. Existing data/SOURCES.md records the same source family.

context.summary: The pre-landfall article identifies Gulf production and Texas refining exposure and notes precautionary production shutdowns. It does not establish the subsequent price effect.
context.locator: Dated article, paragraphs describing regional oil production, refining and precautionary shutdowns

updates.summary: EIA reports lower Gulf refinery inputs and fuel-supply disruption after Harvey. Reduced refinery inputs add a crude-demand risk to a simple supply-disruption thesis; they do not prove a future Brent fall.
updates.locator: Dated article, refinery inputs and operations paragraphs; weekly period ending September 1 is not the publication date

ripple_paths.basis: EIA documents regional production exposure; the downstream direction and business effects are hypotheses, not measured correlations.
EIA documents refining exposure; opposing crude/fuel channels and downstream margins remain hypotheses. No airline, transport or insurance prices are supplied.

timing_note: Article clocks are unestablished: expose each only from the next UTC date. The curated card-file hash is not an archived-page hash. Later weekly findings are never backdated to their measurement period.
